newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC introduces smallest LCD digital camera.
newsitem.headline: NEC introduces smallest LCD digital camera.

text.p: Electronics giant NEC Corp. unveiled in Japan Thursday what it said was the world's smallest digital camera with a liquid crystal display monitor.
The Pinoca camera weighs just 6-1/2 ounces and can fit into a shirt pocket, NEC said in a statement.
NEC said it will begin shipping the camera March 14 and projected sales of 120,000 units in the first year.
The price of a basic model will be 69,800 yen ($562), it added.
The camera is powered by two AA batteries and its pictures can be downloaded into a personal computer for viewing, NEC said.
The company said it was considering selling the camera abroad, but added no decisions had been made.
